survey: A stylized black cat figure sitting on a wooden plank floor, shown three-quarter from the front. Head: two pointed ears rise from the top of the skull, two large yellow eyes with black pupils sit side by side, and a small brown nose sits below them. The head is turned slightly to the cat's right, and the far eye looks smaller because of perspective. Neck: a plain red ring collar goes all the way around the neck and sits where the head meets the body. Body: a pear-shaped seated torso with the haunch bulging on the visible side. Two front legs come down from the chest and end in two front paws resting flat on the planks. Tail: it comes out from behind the haunch, curls forward along the floor and ends beside the front paws. The paws, haunch and tail all touch the floor and cast a contact shadow, so the figure is well supported.
